Dear Sir/Madam,
 RE: RESIGNATION/WITHDRAWAL OF MEMBERSHIP
 FROM THE KENYA NATIONAL UNION OF TEACHERS (KNUT)
I…………………………………………………..….. TSC NUMBER…………….…………
Hereby resigns from being a member of the Kenya National Union of Teachers (KNUT) with
effect from …………………………………..
It is my feeling that the union has failed to represents my needs and interest as I anticipated
when joining.
Kindly withdraw my name from the list of the union members.
Regards
Yours faithfully,
